races.paceDynamic: Pioneer Pete stands alone as the confirmed front runner and should get an uncontested lead, setting a sustainable gallop that plays to his strengths. Behind him, eight runners (Double Tiger, Prince Of Clova, Emerald Time, Chico Magnifica, Hashtag Queen, Collanisi, Asta La Vista, Hellion) all want prominent positions, creating a bunched, competitive group that will generate significant traffic problems approaching the final two hurdles.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pioneer Pete Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Pioneer Pete gets his preferred uncontested lead and the prominent pack gets messy
scenarios.body: Pioneer Pete controls from the front while the congested group behind gets in each other's way turning for home. His proven front-running record on similar going gives him every chance to hold on.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group sets too strong a pace chasing Pioneer Pete
scenarios.body: The eight prominent runners go too hard trying to stay with the leader, setting it up perfectly for the hold-up brigade. Our Guide, Finbarr, and King Esoteric get clear runs late as the early pace collapses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Group Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Pioneer Pete ties up and the prominent runners sort themselves out cleanly
scenarios.body: The pace becomes truly run after halfway as the large prominent group pressures Pioneer Pete into submission. Chico Magnifica and Double Tiger, both proven on this going, emerge from the pack with superior finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Chaos Special
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers or severe interference disrupts the race shape completely
scenarios.body: The cramped conditions and inexperienced field create carnage at a crucial flight, completely reshaping the contest. Lower-rated runners like Asta La Vista or Collanisi benefit from staying out of trouble to claim shock places.

watchPoints.text: Eight runners wanting prominent positions behind Pioneer Pete will create severe traffic problems from three furlongs out
Millford Hill's finishing weakness could cause interference as stronger finishers try to get past
Pioneer Pete's early fractions will determine if this becomes truly run or just steadily run
Our Guide needs the prominent pack to go too hard to set up his hold-up style
Double Tiger and Chico Magnifica have the best combination of rating and tactical position if pace is honest

races.paceDynamic: Giovanni Change, Mixedwave, Holeshot, The Clonmel Kid, and The Great Escape all want prominent positions, creating congestion and a messy early gallop with no natural leader. This false pace will likely collapse into a sprint finish from 3 out, where traffic problems will be crucial as five horses jostle for the same tactical position.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the five prominent runners go too fast early and tire from 2 out
scenarios.body: The pace crumbles and the hold-up horses get perfect splits to come through. Cardamon Hill and Ithaka capitalize on their patient styles with strong late runs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Favors Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Giovanni Change or Holeshot can dictate from the front without interference
scenarios.body: The stronger prominent runners avoid the scramble and maintain galloping rhythm to the line. Class tells as the front pair pull clear of the pack.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Creates Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quintet gets tangled up and neutralizes each other completely
scenarios.body: None of the fancied runners get ideal trips and an outsider sneaks through on the rails or wide. The Great Escape or Slaney Opera capitalize on the chaos with perfect positioning.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: True Pace Emerges Late
scenarios.trigger: If one horse breaks clear from the prominent pack to make genuine running
scenarios.body: A single prominent runner establishes control while others struggle in behind, setting up ideal conditions. The leader holds on as the field spreads out in pursuit.

races.paceDynamic: Ionian, King Of The Road, and Jhentong Enki will ensure a genuine gallop from the start, with King Of The Road showing the most consistent early pace. Nine horses wanting prominent positions creates inevitable congestion approaching the business end, where stamina will separate the wheat from chaff over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Suits Stamina
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders maintain a solid tempo throughout
scenarios.body: The honest gallop plays to horses with proven staying power like Duel Au Soleil and Miss Cynthia who can pick up the pieces. Hold-up horses benefit from the strong pace and can time their runs from the back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Ionian and Jhentong Enki fade quickly leaving King Of The Road alone
scenarios.body: The race becomes tactical with prominent runners able to dictate terms in the straight. Freshers Week and Dirty Den can utilize their class advantage in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos 2-3 Out
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack bunches badly approaching the final obstacles
scenarios.body: Several fancied runners get hampered while those racing clear of trouble capitalize. Duel Au Soleil tracking wide and any leaders still standing benefit from the carnage behind.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuine but not excessive throughout
scenarios.body: The stamina test allows patient rides to flourish as prominent runners weaken. Miss Cynthia and Just Call Me Lucy can utilize their finishing kicks to maximum effect.

watchPoints.text: Bras d'Or and Keno Black both have serious going concerns having performed best on much softer surfaces recently.
Traffic problems inevitable with nine prominent runners creating a bunched field approaching the final obstacles.
No Ordinary Joe's tendency to fade in the finish could be exposed by the strong early gallop.
King Of The Road's pace-setting reliability makes him key to how the race develops from the front.
Miss Cynthia's recent victory and hold-up style perfectly suits a strongly-run staying contest.

races.paceDynamic: With four of five runners wanting prominent positions (Koapey, Gaelic Rambler, Zero Tolerance, Parramount), this creates a congested false pace scenario where no single horse commits to proper front-running. Singapore Trip as the sole hold-up runner faces a tactical nightmare if the prominent quartet go steady early then kick turning in, leaving minimal time to close from behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Scrap Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Koapey or Gaelic Rambler commit to making it a true test from the outset.
scenarios.body: The sustained pace stretches the field and prevents bunching at the business end. Singapore Trip gets the strong gallop needed to unleash his finishing kick from the rear.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: False Pace Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If all four prominent runners refuse to commit early, creating stop-start fractions.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge from 3 out with traffic problems likely in the pack. Parramount and Koapey have the class edge in a messy finish where positions matter hugely.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Gaelic Rambler Takes Charge
scenarios.trigger: If Gaelic Rambler uses his stamina assets to dictate from the front turning in.
scenarios.body: His recent form over longer trips suggests he can sustain a strong gallop when others tire. The tactical advantage of getting first run could prove decisive if he maintains momentum.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Leader
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet get severely hampered 2-3 out in a bunched finish.
scenarios.body: Whoever gets clear running or sneaks up the inner while others are stopped could steal it. Long-shot scenario but possible given the tactical makeup and small field dynamics.

watchPoints.text: Singapore Trip needs the prominent quartet to commit to genuine pace early or faces impossible task from rear in sprint finish.
Traffic problems highly likely 2-3 out with four horses wanting similar prominent positions in small field.
Gaelic Rambler could steal march if he uses stamina advantage to dictate rather than following false pace.
Koapey and Parramount share top ratings but tactical positioning may prove more important than pure class.
Zero Tolerance needs career-best effort but perfect trip from prominent position could see him outrun odds.

This creates a sustainable gallop that will favor the hold-up horses American Mike, Kent De Thaix and Jupiter Des Mottes who can unleash late challenges, though the latter two face significant going concerns on this Good surface.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Thank You Ma'am gets soft fractions and the hold-up horses hit traffic or come too late

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.trigger: If Kent De Thaix or Jupiter Des Mottes handles the Good going better than recent form suggests
scenarios.body: One of the hold-up pair finds the surface more suitable than their profiles indicate and times a late charge perfectly. Their superior class ratings become the deciding factor.

watchPoints.text: Kent De Thaix and Jupiter Des Mottes both show concerning form patterns on Good going and may struggle to be competitive.
American Mike needs the pace to be strong enough to set up his late kick but faces tactical disadvantage as sole pace-dependent runner.
Thank You Ma'am's ability to sustain gallop over 3m will determine if uncontested lead becomes winning advantage.

Ballygeary needs others to overrace or tire dramatically given significant ratings disadvantage in this company.

races.paceDynamic: Jonquilla and Steady The Ship will ensure a genuine gallop from the start, with both possessing natural front-running tendencies. This honest pace should perfectly suit the army of hold-up horses (9 runners), creating late traffic problems but allowing the strongest stayers to emerge. The pace map heavily favors those who can quicken from off the speed in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses collide
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is strong and the field bunches approaching the final hurdle
scenarios.body: Traffic problems will eliminate several chances while those getting clear runs will capitalize on the strong gallop. The best stayer with racing room will prevail in a messy finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runners collapse late
scenarios.trigger: If Jonquilla and Steady The Ship go too fast early and tire dramatically
scenarios.body: The pace will set up perfectly for the patient hold-up horses who get good positioning. A strong closer will sweep past the tiring leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustained gallop throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Jonquilla maintains a steady rhythm without going too fast early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a true test of stamina where class and finishing kick matter most. Those with proven form at this trip will dominate the finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical affair unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If both front runners are restrained early creating a slow pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where positioning at the final hurdle proves crucial. Those nearest the pace will have the advantage in a cavalry charge finish.

Jonquilla's early pace judgment will be crucial as going too fast could set up the closers
Steady The Ship's tactics will determine if there's genuine pace pressure on Jonquilla early

races.paceDynamic: Noble Way is the only horse with confirmed prominent tendencies but lacks the class to sustain a strong gallop, setting up a crawling pace scenario. With most runners being lightly raced and of unknown running style, expect a messy, slowly-run affair that becomes a sprint finish over the final 3-4 furlongs where tactical positioning will be crucial.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Crawling Pace Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If Noble Way sets pedestrian fractions and the field bunches up
scenarios.body: The race becomes a 3-furlong dash where the best turn of foot wins. Lightly raced horses with unknown stamina reserves get found out in a frantic finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Noble Way Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Noble Way gets easy lead and field allows generous splits
scenarios.body: The 110-rated veteran uses experience to dictate terms and holds on grimly. Hold-up horses leave their run too late on the testing ground.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Middlecliffe Timing Perfect
scenarios.trigger: If Middlecliffe avoids his usual fade and gets the trip right
scenarios.body: The proven stayer times his challenge perfectly in the final furlong when others tire. His 12th place last time can be forgiven on softer ground over shorter.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Lottery Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and unknown styles clash
scenarios.body: Multiple lightly raced horses with unproven tactics create chaos in the straight. Any of the unknowns could emerge from the pack with superior natural ability.

A Sight To Sea and Cape Warrior's running styles will reveal crucial information for future handicapping
The good ground may not suit horses who need softer conditions based on recent runs
